content: निवृत् €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> ²1 To come back, return; न च निम्नादिव सलिलं निवर्तते मे ततो हृदयम् <ls>Śi. 3. 2</ls>; <ls>Ku. 4. 30</ls>; <ls>R. 2. 40</ls>; <ls>Bg. 8. 21</ls>, <ls n="Bg.">15. 4</ls>. .²2 To flee from, retreat; रणान्निववृते न च <ls>Bk. 5. 102</ls>. .²3 To turn away from; be averse to; <ls>R. 5. 23</ls>, <ls n="R.">7. 61</ls>. .²4 To cease, desist or abstain from; प्रसमीक्ष्य निवर्तेत सर्वमांसस्य भक्षणात् <ls>Ms. 5. 49</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">1. 53</ls>; <ls>Bk. 1. 18</ls>; निवृत्तमांसस्तु जनकः <ls>U. 4</ls>. .²5 To be freed or absolved from, to escape; कथं न ज्ञेयमस्माभिः पापादस्मान्निवर्तितुम् <ls>Bg. 1. 39</ls>. .²6 To leave off speaking, cease, stop. .²7 To be removed, come to an end, cease, disappear; विषया विनिवर्तन्ते निराहारस्य देहिनः <ls>Bg. 2. 59</ls>, <ls n="Bg.">14. 22</ls>; <ls>Ms. 11. 185</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 11.">186</ls>. .²8 To be accomplished or finished, come to an end. .²9 To be withheld or withdrawn from. .²10 To refuse, decline. .²11 To be engaged in. .²12 To be reversed. .²13 To set (as the sun). .²14 To be forbidden. .²15 To be wanting; यतो वाचो निवर्तन्ते. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To cause to return, send back; निवर्त्य राजा दयितां दयालुः <ls>R. 2. 3</ls>, <ls n="R.">3. 47</ls>, <ls n="R.">7. 44</ls>. .²2 To withdraw, keep away from; turn away, divert; रश्मिष्विवादाय नगेन्द्रसक्तां निवर्तयामास नृपस्य दृष्टिम् <ls>R. 2. 28</ls>; <ls>Ku. 5. 11</ls>. .²3 To accomplish, perform, finish, complete. .²4 To shorten (the hair). .²5 To Annul.
